name: Mama x Kano+ ~Oshiego no Okaa-san ga Ecchi na Sensei de, Musume mo Ecchi ni Nattara Dame Desu ka?~
original_name: ママ×カノ＋ ～教え子のお母さんがエッチな先生で、娘もエッチになったら駄目ですか？～
source:
After finally achieving his dream of becoming a teacher at his alma mater, the protagonist reunites with two pairs of mothers and daughters.
His former teacher, Sawako, and her daughter, Ayumi.
His student, Yuna, and her mother, Ritsu.
Through a series of coincidences, the protagonist ends up entangled with all of them.
At Sawako’s suggestion, he decides to face the situation head-on, leading to a hectic but enjoyable school life.
—The second semester begins, and the season shifts from summer to autumn.
The school uniforms change from summer to winter attire, and suddenly, a hot spring trip is announced!
The destination? Harenchi no Yu (The Hot Springs of Shameless Love).
On top of that, the school’s biggest event, the Houka Festival, is just around the corner…

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ013522.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
主人公终于实现梦想，回到母校任教，并与两对母女重逢。
她们是他曾经的老师佐和子与女儿优奈，以及同为恩师的亚由美与女儿律。优奈和律如今都成了他的学生。
一连串机缘巧合之下，主人公与她们所有人都产生了纠葛。
在佐和子的提议下，他决定坦然面对这一切，开始了忙碌而愉快的校园生活。
——第二学期开始，季节也由夏入秋。
校服从夏装换成冬装，而一场温泉旅行竟突然提上日程！
目的地是“霸恋治之汤”，也就是“放浪恋情之汤”。
与此同时，学校最盛大的活动“丰华祭”也即将到来……
